items.title: Length formula for the dual of a finite length module over a complete local ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the length formula for the module of maps into an injective hull of the residue field over a complete local ring (author lemma at source lines 911-920, label lemma-finite). The proof (source lines 922-939) settles the residue field by essentialness and inducts on the length using exactness of the Hom functor into the injective hull, with the final assertion from evaluating at the ring (proof lines 922-938). The induction step is the substance. H3.
